'''Yelloweye fever''' is a disease which renders the victim unable to stand and causes the whites of their eyes to turn yellow.{{ref/book|1|38}}{{ref/book|twotc|yelloweye fever}}

[[Bili Congar|Bili Congar's]] household contracts yelloweye fever after Bili [[Dark One#True name|names the Dark One]].{{ref/book|1|3}}{{ref/book|twotc|Bili Congar}}

[[Nynaeve al'Meara]] rules out yelloweye fever as the reason for [[Perrin Aybara|Perrin's]] irises turning yellow.{{ref/book|1|38}}
